newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates rise sharply on operation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates rise sharply on operation.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates jumped to 20 percent on Wednesday from Tuesday's close at 1.00 percent after a central bank weekly open market operation that picked up some three billion rupees, dealers said.
The overnight rates touched 20 percent and discounting of about four billion rupees was reported from the State (central) Bank of Pakistan window, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
The rates were expected to remain high on Thursday, the dealer said. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
